notes: ABox contraction paired with biology-replace-0004: removes its original fact (in DNA, cytosine pairs with guanine). dna_partner_of (symmetric) is functional. Own questions (direct, paraphrase, cross-lingual, propositional) expect 'does not know'. Cardinality question: whether cytosine pairs with cytosine in DNA (no before, not known after). Related: whether cytosine's partner is a purine (composition through guanine's chemical class). Derived: two 2-hop questions that reach the subject or object by description and use a fact stored by name that does not mention the removed fact (the nucleoside of the partner base (the DNA form deoxyguanosine is accepted) and whether that base is also found in RNA). Unrelated near: RNA's partner for adenine (uracil) (contraction is exempt from Rule 7). Known weakness: other stored pairing rules (purine with pyrimidine, C with G in RNA) can rebuild part of the removed pair.
